children.name: Pasteurella multocida
children.authorship: (Lehmann and Neumann 1899) Rosenbusch and Merchant 1939 (Approved Lists 1980)
children.description: Pasteurella multocida is a Gram-negative, nonmotile, penicillin-sensitive coccobacillus from the family Pasteurellaceae.

children.name: Haemophilus influenzae
children.description: Haemophilus influenzae (formerly called Pfeiffer's bacillus or Bacillus influenzae) is a Gram-negative, non-motile, coccobacillary, facultatively anaerobic, capnophilic pathogenic bacterium of the family Pasteurellaceae.

children.name: Actinobacillus suis
children.description: Actinobacillus suis is a beta-haemolytic, Gram-negative bacterium of the family Pasteurellaceae.

children.name: Actinobacillus capsulatus
children.authorship: Arseculeratne 1962 (Approved Lists 1980) emend. Kuhnert et al. 2007

children.name: Histophilus somni
children.description: Histophilus somni is a non-motile, gram-negative, rod or coccobacillus shaped, facultative anaerobe bacterial species belonging to the family Pasteurellaceae.
